label: Icon With Content
purpose: One icon + heading + text item inside a horizontal ticker
_notes:
'icon' names a material-icon (e.g. 'local_shipping', 'verified_user'). 'text' is richtext and MUST be wrapped in

tags. Leave 'image' empty '' — only use it if you want a custom image instead of the icon; images are filled in outside of you. Distinct from icon-with-content (hyphenated) used elsewhere — this one is horizontal-ticker's own version. Add 8-10 blocks minimum with unique content for smooth scrolling.
